messages:
Kendall (People Ops): Final grace reminder: evidence window closes next Tue (Apr 20). This is the last automated pass before we snapshot for SOC2/ISO. Please upload manager attestations + team CSVs.
Kendall (People Ops): Quick checklist on Confluence: https://redwood-internal.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/COMPLIANCE/pages/Evidence-Upload - use the protected uploads folder only.
Jordan (Security): Required CSV header (exact): employee_email,display_name,role,training_name,training_completed_at,cert_url. Timestamps must be ISO8601 UTC.
Priya (Compliance): Managers: signed attestation (fillable PDF) + CSV for all team members including contractors. If you have contractors, add column vendor_name and is_contractor=true.
Ethan (Eng Manager): If someone is traveling and can't sign, can manager attest on their behalf?
Priya (Compliance): Yes — manager may note the exception in the attestation and include reason/date. Keep a DM or email proving the team member agreed when possible.
contractor-bot: Reminder: Contractors must be listed in vendor CSV by Apr 20 per People Ops.
Kendall (People Ops): If your certs didn't auto-sync to Okta, download PDF and upload to Confluence uploads. Filename: teamname_lastname_firstname_cert.pdf.
Jordan (Security): Note for infra teams: include a one-line inventory of data stores you access in the attestation (e.g., s3://redwood-prod-logs, pg-prod-cluster). Helps auditors map controls.
Ethan (Eng Manager): Can we get an early CSV export? Some teams need it before Apr 18.
Kendall (People Ops): We can run early exports on Apr 17 for teams that request by Apr 14. Reply here with team slug.
Priya (Compliance): Last call: avoid publishing evidence in shared drives. Use the Confluence protected folder or the portal uploader. If you hit permission errors, DM me and Kendall with screenshot.
Kendall (People Ops): Thanks all — we'll send a final manager digest tomorrow and targeted nudges on Apr 18. If you need a 48-hour extension, DM me and include your manager's approval. :raised_hands:
